title: Coherence of the concrete restricted single-complex coefficient system
statement: Let S be a scheme, I a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S any diagram and c any cone. Let F_i and phi be abelian etale sheaves and inverse-image coefficient transitions satisfying the identity and composition HEq laws, and H a diagram on c.pt with isomorphisms eH to the pullbacks of F_i and the canonical transition equation. Assume H has a colimit. For any etale U over S, use the concrete D', c', K, G, L of [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction]. There exist inverse-image complex transitions psi and cone comparison isomorphisms eG satisfying the identity, composition, and G transition laws in lean.statement. Additionally eG_i.inv followed by the concrete L injection equals mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor followed by singleFunctor.map of rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient along the cone leg with coefficient eH_i.inv followed by colimit.iota_i. This is an equality of complex morphisms, before applying Q or cohomology. No geometric limit, compactness, affine transition, colimit universal property, lower bound, or cohomology comparison is asserted here. The names D', c', K, G, and L are explicit parameters, required by one equality and four heterogeneous equalities to be exactly the stated concrete constructions. This allows the coherence formulas to be expressed using these names without repeatedly unfolding their implementation. The final equality is written as HEq to accommodate these names; specializing the data equalities makes its two morphism types identical.

proof.text: First substitute hD' and the four heterogeneous data equalities, reducing to the concrete constructions. Define psi by the single functor applied to rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient for each transition, preceded by mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor. Pullback projection identities identify the relevant composites. The unit and associativity equations of upperStarComp, together with the given phi laws, imply the identity and composition laws after applying the single functor.

For each cone leg q_i, write r_i and r for the stage and limit second projections. The equality r followed by c_i = q_i followed by r_i identifies the two composite inverse images. Restrict eH_i along r, use upperStarComp on the two sides of this equality, and invert mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor to obtain eG_i. Naturality and associativity of these comparisons and hH give hG. Inverting eG_i and composing with L.iota_i cancels the image of eH_i and leaves exactly the two upperStarComp factors and restricted coefficient map used by rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. Naturality of the single comparison gives the stated equality of complex maps.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restricted_affine_single_coherence {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H]
    (U : S.Etale)
    (D' : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{v}) (c' : Cone D')
    (K : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (D'.obj i).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (G : (Iᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Sheaf c'.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (L : Cocone G)
    (hD' : D' = restrictedAffineDiagram D U)
    (hc' : HEq c' (restrictedAffineCone D c U))
    (hK : HEq K (restrictedAffineK D F U))
    (hG' : HEq G (restrictedAffineG D c H U))
    (hL' : HEq L (restrictedAffineL D c H U)) :
    ∃
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : j ⟶ i),
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i) ⟶ K j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (D'.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : Iᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j),
      ψ (g ≫ f) =
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g) (D'.map f)
            (D'.map (g ≫ f)) (D'.map_comp g f))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (eG : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, G.obj (op i) ≅
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app j) (D'.map f)
            (c'.π.app i) (c'.w f).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ (eG j).inv),
    ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ,
      HEq ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app (op i))
        (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
          ((restrictedAffineCone D c U).π.app i)).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom (D.obj i).hom)).obj
              (F i.unop)) ≫
        (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          (rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient (c.π.app i).left (D.obj i).hom c.pt.hom
            (Over.w (c.π.app i)) (F i.unop) (colimit H)
            ((eH i.unop).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i.unop) U))
